opportunities.Title: Advantix:  National Channel Manager
opportunities.BriefDescription:
Summary:
The National Channel Manager will be responsible for engaging with the Tech Brokers, to promote Advantix Solutions and update on Partner opportunities. The NCM will focus on training Partners on Advantix Solutions, join customer calls to do Discovery, provide an overview of solutions, portal demo of capabilities and working with the Partner and Customer to sign contracts. Once a contract is signed, the Channel Manager will provide a hand off to the Implementation Teammates for kick off.

opportunities.Title: Advantix:  Solutions Architect
opportunities.BriefDescription: We are looking for a Solutions Architect who thrives at the intersection of technology, sales and customer relationships. You will partner closely with Advantix teams and clients to uncover business challenges, actively listen to goals and translate those insights into thoughtful, innovative solution options. You'll play a key part in pre sales engineering helping guide customers through complex situations with calm expertise. Success in this role comes from curiosity, creativity and the ability to think beyond immediate circumstances. You'll build strong connections with partners and continuously exchange knowledge to elevate the overall client experience. If you enjoy collaborating, problem solving, and crafting solutions that make a difference, then this is a place where you can shine.

opportunities.Title: 2nd Shift - Truck Loader/Stacker
opportunities.BriefDescription: As a Truck Loader/Stacker you will operate forklift equipment to properly wrap product to ensure proper weight, wrap, stage and load of pallets unto trailer. You will also be required to manually stack boxes on pallets, following specific stacking patterns and safety guidelines. This position is full-time, Monday through Friday, from 1:30 PM to 10PM, with the expectation to work extended hours when necessary to meet business needs

opportunities.BriefDescription: The Escalation Specialist reviews and validates incoming escalations, determines the best path for resolution, and coordinates resolution efforts across partners, suppliers, and internal teams. This role is responsible for timely communication, accurate documentation, issue tracking, partner updates, and reporting insights that support continuous improvement.

opportunities.Title: Intelisys:  Partner Success Representative - West
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Partner Success Representative role is responsible for managing and supporting the lifecycle of supplier quotes and related actions by reviewing inbound communications, processing assigned tasks, and ensuring timely follow-up with suppliers, partners, and internal stakeholders. It involves maintaining accurate records, documenting progress, and leveraging systems to track activity and outcomes. The position also plays a key role in coordinating pricing-related actions, responding to requests, and monitoring ongoing workflows to ensure nothing is missed. Additionally, the role requires collaboration and flexibility, including providing backup support to team members to maintain operational continuity and efficiency.

opportunities.Title: Account Manager LIC - Continuous Posting
opportunities.BriefDescription:
*This posting is a continuous posting for sales opportunities opening in the immediate future.  While there may already be sales opportunities currently posted, our advisement is to submit for both this posting and the individual sales opportunities.

The Account Manager is responsible for driving sales with both new and existing customers. Account Managers are responsible for managing the inbound interactions from customers within a specific segment and includes generating quotes, fielding and responding to inquiries, driving deals to closure, processing orders, and overflow quotes and orders. This individual will navigate internal departments and resources to answer customer inquiries and effectively close deals.

opportunities.Title: SAP Business Analyst II
opportunities.BriefDescription:
An SAP Business Analyst Level II is responsible for supporting the design, configuration, testing, and implementation of solutions within their functional area of expertise (Finance, Sales, Merchandising, RFS, Customer Service & Returns Management). A Level II executes assigned project tasks within established timelines and works closely with senior analysts, managers, and business stakeholders to support business processes and system enhancements.

The Level II assists in identifying and resolving system issues, gathering business requirements, and supporting user adoption of new functionality. They work with the SAP Manager and Business Process Owners to help ensure systems meet business requirements and support operational objectives.

opportunities.Title: Supply Chain Purchasing Specialist - Networking
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Supply Chain Purchasing Specialist is responsible for processing drop shipment Purchase Orders to meet SLA and accuracy guidelines, maintain updated ETAs on all open orders in SAP, and provide sales support as needed.

opportunities.BriefDescription: The Purchasing Specialist III is responsible for maintaining levels of inventory for assigned supplier line(s) consistent with the business plan that maximize sales, inventory turns and return on inventory.

opportunities.Title: Resourcive:  Senior Consultant
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Senior Consultant owns assigned client relationships end to end, from initial scoping and kickoff through governance, delivery, and scope expansion. You will lead a team of consultants and an implementation manager, coordinate the technology practice leads engaged on your accounts, and act as the primary point of contact for client executives and their private equity owners. Beyond managing delivery, the Senior Consultant is expected to actively listen for and develop new workstreams that create value for the client and revenue for Resourcive, while holding the full extended team accountable to the process and timeline. Because a slipping schedule directly risks the client relationship, urgency and milestone discipline are central to the role.

opportunities.Title: ScanSource Spark 2027 Summer Internship
opportunities.BriefDescription: The ScanSource Spark Internship Program offers a way for students to prepare for their future after college. The ScanSource Spark Internship is a 10 week program only offered in the summer of 2027. Paid internship opportunities are available for undergraduates who are students graduating in August 2027, December 2027, or May 2028 in the areas of sales, merchandising, marketing, supply chain, people & culture, customer service, or technical support.

opportunities.Title: 2nd Shift - Invoicer (Shipping)
opportunities.BriefDescription: Responsible for accurately invoicing and processing outgoing orders in a timely manner. This position is full-time, Monday through Friday, from 1:00 PM to 9:30PM, with the expectation to work extended hours when necessary to meet business needs.

opportunities.Title: Design Engineer I - Comms
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Design Engineer I represents a high level of technical expertise to internal and external customers in a variety of forms that include design assistance, delivering education, and enabling the customer to do business with ScanSource.  The focus of the position may be on specified technologies, or on a specific group of suppliers. This role is expected to be an expert in Network Technologies and will act as a trusted advisor to the company's customers.  This individual would have detailed knowledge of a multiple product lines, and able to guide a customer through designing the best overall solution which would include hardware, software, and licensing.

opportunities.Title: Inventory/Receiving Lead
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Inventory & Receiving Lead serves as the subject matter expert (SME), trainer, and primary escalation point for the Inventory and Receiving team. This role provides day-to-day direction to receiving and inventory associates, ensures Inventory and Receiving accuracy and operational excellence. The Inventory & Receiving Lead is responsible for maintaining Inventory integrity, overseeing receiving processes, resolving complex inventory discrepancies, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and driving efficiency, accuracy, and accountability across inventory and receiving operations.

opportunities.Title: Accounts Receivable Analyst I
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Accounts Receivable Analyst I ("AR Analyst I") supports the management of secured and unsecured customer accounts through account reconciliation, dispute research, deduction resolution, and customer account maintenance activities. This role contributes to the organization's cash flow objectives by assisting with the timely resolution of outstanding receivable balances while delivering a positive customer experience.

opportunities.Title: Channel Exchange:  Microsoft Copilot Specialist
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Microsoft Copilot Specialist plays an important role in the Channel Exchange sales process. The Copilot Specialist is part of a team of resources we provide our customers and sales partners to help them understand, position, adopt, and expand Microsoft Copilot solutions through Channel Exchange. Copilot Specialists have consistent involvement with our customers and partners, mostly related to their Microsoft Copilot requirements, readiness, use cases, licensing considerations, and adoption strategy. Copilot Specialists are subject matter experts supporting both our customers and the various sales resources within Channel Exchange.

opportunities.Title: UI Developer III
opportunities.BriefDescription:
The UI Developer III role is primarily focused on leading the implementation and delivery of clean, usable, modern user interfaces that improve our platforms while setting a high standard for front-end engineering quality.

This position involves building new features in React, maintaining and modernizing existing platform features, and helping establish style guides, reusable patterns, modular components, and interface standards for modern UI development.

opportunities.Title: Sr. Tax Associate
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Senior Tax Associate is an opportunity for a highly motivated tax professional to play an integral role within the corporate tax function to support income tax compliance, assist with tax provisions, and contribute to tax planning and strategy initiatives.

opportunities.Title: Intelisys:  Regional Channel Manager
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Regional Channel Manager is responsible for all aspects of sales of the Intelisys opportunity to assigned sales partners. The Regional Channel Manager will be responsible for growing assigned rising sales partners in a specific region as well as the recruitment of new partners. Responsibilities include creating a proactive sales function to optimize revenue opportunities and growth from assigned sales partners, on-boarding and stewarding of sales partners, sales of enhanced services, and other opportunities as identified. This assignment is a quota bearing sales position with complete responsibility for achieving 100% of annual targets for assigned sales partners their net billings, gross commissions, and gross profits.

opportunities.Title: 2nd Shift - Picker Forklift Operator

This role focuses on building and supporting a high-performing team that delivers clean, usable, modern user interfaces while establishing strong front-end engineering practices across our platforms.

opportunities.Title: Advantix:  Growth Operations & Revenue Technology Director
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Growth Operations and Revenue Technology Director leads operational execution, systems governance, automation, measurement, and scalable processes for Advantix’s Sales and Marketing Operations. Reporting to the VP of Connectivity Experience & Sales Operations, this role connects Marketing, Sales, Channel, Product, Operations, RevOps, and Business Systems to turn approved go-to-market, partner, OEM, campaign, and enablement strategies into repeatable execution. The Director ensures systems, data, workflows, content deployment, partner programs, and reporting operate as an integrated revenue execution engine, while strategic ownership remains with the appropriate functional leaders.

opportunities.Title: Resourcive:  Cyber Advisor
opportunities.BriefDescription: We are looking for a Cyber Security Advisor to join our Cyber Practice and deliver directly to clients. This is not a sales role, not a tools implementation role, and not an internal security role. It is a client-facing advisory position for someone who has already made the transition from practitioner to consultant and is ready to operate with significant autonomy.

opportunities.Title: Intelisys:  Supplier Business Manager
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Supplier Business Manager is responsible for managing the relationship and driving results with assigned new and strategic suppliers in the Intelisys portfolio. The Supplier Business Manager acts as a primary point of contact for assigned Supplier(s) to share information and works closely with Sales, Support, Marketing, and Supplier representatives to ensure positive working relationships and growth within assigned Supplier(s). The ideal candidate has at least 4 years of corporate work experience, ideally in telecom/technology fields and knowledgeable with SaaS and recurring revenue models.

opportunities.Title: Manager, Technical Solutions - Converged Communications
opportunities.BriefDescription: The Manager of Technical Solutions is responsible for leading a team of Design Engineers and Technicians focused on the architecture, design, validation, and support of enterprise video collaboration, unified communications (UC), contact center, and telecommunications solutions. This role oversees the development of technical solution designs, and pre-sale / post-sale technical serves as a key escalation point for complex customer requirements involving technologies from leading manufacturers and service providers related communications collaboration ecosystems.

opportunities.Title: Regional Vice President, Sales - West/Mountain
opportunities.BriefDescription: We are looking for a Regional VP, Partner Sales, that would take responsibility as Leader of a regional sales team comprised of Sales Director(s) and Business Development Managers.  This role will report directly to the SVP of Sales and will include working with the leadership team to build strategy, sales plans, and overall team management. The ideal candidate will have experience establishing and building partner relationships, an aggressive sales strategy, and an ability to closely manage a large pipeline of opportunities. The RVP of Sales you will lead, motivate, challenge, and develop a regional sales team, and you creatively drive efforts to strategically prospect and develop new business partners.

opportunities.Title: Intelisys:  Senior UI Software Developer
opportunities.BriefDescription:
The Senior UI Developer’s primary responsibility is to implement and ship beautiful user interfaces that bring a modern touch to our platforms.

The role requires integrating with legacy application code, maintaining and modernizing existing features and tools, and contributing to the development of platform style guides and user interface standards.

As a liaison to several different groups — from designers and developers to project management and stakeholders — effective communication is important to the success of the role. As a senior position, being heavily involved in pushing design capabilities and improving user experience while mentoring and coaching less experienced team members is expected.
